headline: Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse Ignite Amid Relentless Frontline Clashes
war_summary: Intense combat across the front has concentrated heavily into Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse over the past three hours, where relentless assaults have driven continuous base turnovers at Crow's Nest, Outwich Ranch, and Rotdust right up to the midnight wire. In Callum's Cape, heavy butcher's bills persist alongside fresh exchanges around Naofa and Scout's Jest, maintaining its position as one of the fiercest battlegrounds on the map. Meanwhile, strategic base transitions have paused across Mooring County and Marban Hollow, though Mooring continues to swallow massive drafts with over three thousand combined casualties in the latest two-hour bracket alone. Outlying skirmishes in the island sectors, including Lykos Isle and The Fingers, have quieted following earlier contests, leaving the core northern and central sectors as the decisive theaters of struggle.
